verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API whose endpoints cover analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts and labels. It also offers webhooks and custom channels, plus an official MCP server that lets agents act on conversations, contacts, calendar and drafts. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, and rate limits are tight (5 concurrent requests, about 1 req/s sustained over 15 minutes). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim or a coverage map for UI features like rules, snoozing, canned responses, team chat and settings, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
